description: The DuckDB releases scripts/libduckdb.py can install for tests on this release branch. Only testoperator's append tests use it: their file_append source generates TPC-H data with the installed DuckDB through crates/duckdb-oracle (1.5.0 or later), so the data matches the official answers in crates/test-framework/src/queries/validation/tpch. Keep the list in ascending order: the last entry is the default. Each entry records the SHA-256 of its shared-library archive per platform, which scripts/libduckdb.py checks before installing it.
